what.en: Fix the problems listed below and see them through. Before anything that writes, show me the dry run and wait for my yes. At a step only I can do, stop, tell me exactly what to do, and go on when I say it is done.
what.zh: 修好下面列出的问题，做到底。会写入的步骤先给我看演练结果，等我同意再执行；只有我能做的那一步，停下来告诉我具体做什么，我说做完了你再接着做。

pointers.en: Each fact is one problem from the Environments panel as JSON (id, env, target, title_zh, steps, ai_task, ref, workdir); `workdir` is the folder on this machine to work in, so run every `bin/agent-env` command there. When the fact has `command_prefix`, put it before every `bin/agent-env` command. When it has `manifest: null`, the panel found no personal manifest and `workdir` is only the folder of the agent-env tool: find the folder that holds manifest/habits.toml or ask me before running anything. Handle them one at a time and follow each one's steps. A step with confirm: true is a write: show me its dry run (or, when there is none, exactly what you will change) and wait for my yes before running it for real. A step with who: user is mine alone (pasting into an app, logging in, supplying a repository): do every step before it, then stop, give me what I need for it (show the text and copy it to the clipboard when you can), say where and what to do, and go on with the later steps only after I tell you it is done. When a step says to stop (a precondition is not met, or something changed), stop there and report; do not skip ahead. For a host upgrade, check the vendor's own release notes or documentation online and test on the machine, as section 3 of the agent-env skill describes. Run `bin/agent-env status --json --all` first and work from its current output, not only the list below. Each cell's `fix` is a command or a one-line remedy. Show me each command before running it. When done, run the status again and tell me which cells are still drift or missing.
pointers.zh: 每条事实是面板里的一个问题（JSON：id、env、target、title_zh、steps、ai_task、ref、workdir）；`workdir` 是本机要在里面干活的目录，`bin/agent-env` 命令都在那里运行。事实里有 `command_prefix` 时，把它加在每条 `bin/agent-env` 命令前面。事实里 `manifest` 为 null 时，面板没找到个人清单，`workdir` 只是 agent-env 工具自己的目录：先找到 manifest/habits.toml 所在的文件夹，找不到就问我，再运行命令。逐条处理，按它的 steps 做；confirm 为 true 的步骤是写操作：先给我看演练结果（没有演练就给我看具体要改什么），等我同意再正式执行。who 为 user 的步骤只有我能做（在 app 里粘贴、登录、提供仓库地址）：先做完它前面的步骤，然后停下，把这一步要用的内容给我（显示全文，能复制到剪贴板就复制），说清在哪里做、做什么，等我回复做完了再接着做后面的步骤。步骤里写了要停下的（前置条件没满足，或发现有变化），就停在那里报告，不要跳过。宿主升级按 agent-env skill 第 3 节的做法核对：联网查厂商自己的发布说明或文档，再在那台机器上实测。先运行 `bin/agent-env status --json --all`，以它当前的输出为准，不只看下面的列表。每格的 `fix` 是一条命令或一句修法。每条命令运行前先给我看。做完再跑一次 status，告诉我还有哪些格是不一致或缺失。

what.en: Prepare the problem below for me to finish: do the steps marked who: ai, run write commands only as a dry run, and tell me exactly what I need to do or confirm, and where.
what.zh: 把下面这个问题准备好，留给我收尾：做 who 为 ai 的步骤，写操作只跑演练（dry run），然后告诉我具体要做什么、确认什么、在哪里做。

pointers.en: The fact is one issue from `bin/agent-env status --json --all`; its `workdir` is the folder on this machine to run commands in. When the fact has `command_prefix`, put it before every `bin/agent-env` command. When it has `manifest: null`, the panel found no personal manifest and `workdir` is only the folder of the agent-env tool: find the folder that holds manifest/habits.toml or ask me before running anything. Run the status first and work from its current output. Never run `--yes` or anything that writes to another machine or a cloud app; that step is mine after I have seen the dry run. For a step on another machine, give me the one command to run there.
pointers.zh: 事实是 `bin/agent-env status --json --all` 里的一条 issue，它的 `workdir` 是本机运行命令的目录。事实里有 `command_prefix` 时，把它加在每条 `bin/agent-env` 命令前面。事实里 `manifest` 为 null 时，面板没找到个人清单，`workdir` 只是 agent-env 工具自己的目录：先找到 manifest/habits.toml 所在的文件夹，找不到就问我，再运行命令。先跑一次 status，以当前输出为准。不要执行 `--yes` 或任何会写到另一台机器、云端 app 的操作，那一步等我看过演练后自己确认。要在另一台机器上做的步骤，给我在那台机器上跑的一条命令。

what.en: Find out why the check below did not produce a result: read its logs, say whether the agent or the checker is at fault, and suggest the fix. Do not change anything yet.
what.zh: 查清下面这个检查为什么没出结果：读它的日志，判断是 agent 的问题还是检查工具自己的问题，给出修法。先不要改任何东西。

pointers.en: Work in the folder the fact names as `workdir`. When the fact has `command_prefix`, put it before every `bin/agent-env` command. When it has `manifest: null`, the panel found no personal manifest and `workdir` is only the folder of the agent-env tool: find the folder that holds manifest/habits.toml or ask me before running anything. Spot-check results and log paths are in `bin/agent-env status --json --all` under `eval.results[].detail`; runs are under `~/.local/state/agent-env/eval/`. You may re-run the one spot-check named in the fact with `bin/agent-env eval`.
pointers.zh: 在事实里 `workdir` 写的目录里做。事实里有 `command_prefix` 时，把它加在每条 `bin/agent-env` 命令前面。事实里 `manifest` 为 null 时，面板没找到个人清单，`workdir` 只是 agent-env 工具自己的目录：先找到 manifest/habits.toml 所在的文件夹，找不到就问我，再运行命令。规则测试结果和日志路径在 `bin/agent-env status --json --all` 的 `eval.results[].detail` 里；运行记录在 `~/.local/state/agent-env/eval/`。可以用 `bin/agent-env eval` 重新做事实里点名的那项规则测试。

what.en: Change which plugins each environment gets, as I describe below. Edit only the `plugins` lists of the manifest's targets, and only within what each environment allows. Show me the diff before writing.
what.zh: 按我下面说的，调整每个环境拿到哪些插件。只改清单里各落点的 `plugins`，只在每个环境允许的范围内改；写入前先给我看改动。

placeholder.en: Which environment should get or drop which plugin?
placeholder.zh: 哪个环境要加上或去掉哪个插件？

pointers.en: The fact is the Plugins tab as JSON: every plugin with its visibility, per environment its deny_visibility, mode and each target's plugins, `manifest`, the manifest file to edit, and `workdir`, the folder to run `bin/agent-env` commands in. Edit that manifest file. When `manifest` is null the panel found no personal manifest: stop and ask me where it is. When the fact has `command_prefix`, put it before every `bin/agent-env` command. Change only `plugins = [...]` of [[targets]]; never add a plugin whose visibility is in that environment's deny_visibility (Grok Bot denies company), and keep local plugins last. Do not add or remove [plugins.*], change a plugin's visibility or repo, or touch [environments]: if what I ask needs that, stop and tell me. An environment in mode legacy has no plugins yet; moving it onto plugins is a later phase, so ask before attaching any. Show the diff and wait for my yes before writing. After writing, run `bin/agent-env check` and `bin/agent-env status --json --all`, and tell me what each environment now gets. Do not build, publish, push or deliver anything.
pointers.zh: 事实是「插件」标签的 JSON：每个插件和它的可见性，每个环境的 deny_visibility、mode 和各落点挂的插件，以及 `manifest`（要改的清单文件）和 `workdir`（运行 `bin/agent-env` 命令的目录）。在那个清单文件里改。`manifest` 为 null 时，面板没找到个人清单：停下来问我它在哪。事实里有 `command_prefix` 时，把它加在每条 `bin/agent-env` 命令前面。只改 [[targets]] 的 `plugins = [...]`；不许给环境挂它 deny_visibility 里的可见性的插件（Grok Bot 禁止公司插件），本机插件放最后。不新增或删除 [plugins.*]，不改插件的 visibility 或 repo，不动 [environments]：我要的改动需要这些就停下告诉我。mode 为 legacy 的环境还没改成插件，改过去是后面的阶段，挂插件前先问我。写入前给我看改动，等我同意。写完跑 `bin/agent-env check` 和 `bin/agent-env status --json --all`，告诉我每个环境现在拿到什么。不要生成、发布、推送或投递任何东西。
